**benchmark — not_conveyed**

The letter reports the account's own performance figures (3.7% net, 3.9% gross for Q2, 5.3% YTD, 8.2% since inception) but never mentions the age-based policy blend comparison index or its 4.1% Q2 2026 return. There is no reference anywhere to a benchmark, index, or relative performance comparison — the omission also means readers cannot see that the account trailed its benchmark by 0.4 percentage points net.

points.evidence: The letter contains no mention of any comparison index, benchmark, or the 4.1% figure. The performance paragraph lists only account returns: "a return of 3.7% net of fees (3.9% gross of fees)... the return was 5.3% net of fees... the annualized return has been 8.2% net of fees." No relative or benchmark comparison appears anywhere in the letter.
